ITEM 1 | Crisp-looking pale green lettuce leaves with ruffled, wavy edges and lighter white-green ribs, forming a loose cluster about 8 cm across on the left-center of the plate, slightly glossy with moisture | 55
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green lettuce leaves with translucent, slightly wilted edges, folded over each other in a small heap about 5 cm across at the lower-left rim of the plate | 30
ITEM 3 | Thin green stalks, possibly long narrow vegetable strips, lying in a fan across the top of the greens, bright green with a smooth, slightly glossy surface, about 6 cm long | 12
ITEM 4 | Grey-pink to pale fish-like piece with a flaky, moist-looking surface and a faint sheen, about 5 by 4 cm, sitting beside the greens at upper right | 45
ITEM 5 | Pale cream-colored portion with a speckled, herb-flecked crust showing fine green bits and light browning on edges, about 7 by 4 cm, firm with a slightly dry, grainy surface, placed at lower right of the plate | 70
ITEM 6 | Small orange-pink chunks, soft and moist-looking with a glossy sheen, about 3 cm across, tucked among the lettuce at center | 15
ITEM 7 | Thin fine green herb sprigs, feathery and dry-looking, scattered across the fish and cream portion at right, under 5 cm long | 2
